author: Fextralife
description:
Wo Long 2 DEMO Impressions - FUN But A Little Rough...
In this Fextralife video, I'm going to be talking about my hands-on impressions with Wo Long 2 Wings of Ember. I got to play the demo that's available on Steam. If you haven't played it yet, I highly advise going to check it out. If you are a fan of Team Ninja and games like Nioh and Sekiro and stuff like that.
